game.name: Tobu Tobu Girl
game.desc: Tobu Tobu Girl is a vertical platformer for the original Game Boy in which you play as a girl trying to reach the sky. Jump on enemies to bounce ever higher, collecting power-ups and dodging hazards across five distinct worlds. Made by Tangram Games and released as freeware in 2017, it's a love letter to the Game Boy's hardware with a chiptune soundtrack and crisp pixel art.
